body:
This is an issue with the compatibility renderer's linear <-> srgb conversion function. Every frame, the color is being put through linear_to_srgb(srgb_to_linear(color)), and the error accumulates every frame. 

Swapping the conversion functions that are used for compat [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4254946de93bab0cc1fb36a7b9039c9ec43be924/drivers/gles3/shaders/tonemap_inc.glsl#L13-L26) with the conversion function from [this math library in core](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4254946de93bab0cc1fb36a7b9039c9ec43be924/core/math/color.h#L188-L200) stops the issue from occurring. Using [these conversion functions](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/4254946de93bab0cc1fb36a7b9039c9ec43be924/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/copy_to_fb.glsl#L121-L130) also solves the problem.
